culprit_citations.quoted_text: Homeward, Inc. | Growth Capital Loan ( 19.00 % interest rate, 9.75 % EOT payment) | 12/30/2021 | 3,053 | 3,358 | 3,319 | 6/30/2026

findings.detail: The 19.00 value is a fixed stated interest rate for Homeward, Inc., not a basis spread.

rationale: C115 flagged basis_spread=19.0. The raw SOI row for Homeward, Inc. states 'Growth Capital Loan ( 19.00 % interest rate, 9.75 % EOT payment)' and contains no Prime/SOFR/reference-rate spread language. The pipeline therefore placed a fixed coupon into basis_spread rather than leaving basis_spread empty and treating 19.00 as the stated interest rate.
